name: cpp_unit_tests_benchmark_data_with_splits
description: A collection of C++ projects with unit tests split for benchmarking code generation and automated repair systems. It is intended to measure whether generated code passes the provided unit tests and to enable evaluation of models that produce or modify C++ code. The dataset includes predefined train/validation/test splits to support reproducible evaluation.
reputation: Public dataset on Hugging Face used by researchers building and evaluating code-generation and test-generation models; moderately used in the code-ML community.
